questions.question: Which claim is supported by the measured update duty fraction?
options: The fraction of local job wall time inside synchronized updates
The accelerator will be occupied by the same fraction
The same worker count meets any bursty arrival pattern
questions.explanation: The timing boundary is an application measurement. Hardware occupancy and queue latency require additional evidence from the actual target workload.
optionFeedback: The timing boundary is an application measurement. Hardware occupancy and queue latency require additional evidence from the actual target workload.
Device occupancy needs device-level evidence. This timer measures how the local worker divides its wall time.
A synchronized loop excludes queueing and burst arrivals. Use a load test for service-level latency claims.
